item.title: Itzy’s Chaeryeong steps into spotlight with solo debut ‘Lovesick’
item.description:
Korea Herald • Debut / new group
After nearly eight years with Itzy, Chaeryeong is stepping into the spotlight on her own, hoping to show a side of herself that has taken years to develop. The singer released her first solo EP, “Lovesick,” on Monday, becoming the third Itzy bandmate to pursue a solo career, following Yeji in March 2025 and Yuna in March this year.
